summary: IMPLEMENTED dev_supervisor/repair.py (python -B -m dev_supervisor.repair [--yes] [--allow-while-running]): finds role main / authoritative / ACTIVE|RETIRING records that are not main.json's session and whose process is not alive (record pid or session-file pid, injectable probe), proposes authoritative=false + status RETIRED_STALE with a reason/time note. Dry run reads without any store recovery or cleanup, so it writes nothing. --yes writes the sessions document once through StateStore (backup kept), appends a state_repaired event, refuses when a live process holds the supervisor lock unless --allow-while-running (never edits main.json or the lock), never deletes records. TESTED: 38 offline tests. OBSERVED: one live dry run (see commands). NOT TESTED: --yes against real state (Main decides); behaviour with a real live second Main process. A record with no pid evidence at all is treated as 'no process found' and proposed for retirement; a probe that raises is treated as alive.
